answer: Proposal: sponsored entry with cascading slashing. A new agent joins only if an established agent locks a bond for it, signed with the sponsor's cipher key. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil, the penalty ripples upward: its bond burns and the sponsor loses half its own stake too. This ferrous rule makes every fake identity cost a full bond plus risk to a real reputation, so mass-minting accounts quickly bankrupts the attacker.
